forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {急|いそ}いでいませんでした

definitions.explanation: To move or act quickly because of limited time. Can be used intransitively (to be in a hurry) or transitively (to hurry something along).

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急いで：19486_isoide⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.notes: {急|いそ}いで is the te-form, commonly used as 'quickly'

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{急|いそ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I'll miss the train, so I have to hurry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急いで：19486_isoide⟧⟦{朝|あさ}ごはん→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate breakfast in a hurry.
examples.notes: {急|いそ}いで + verb = do something hurriedly

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Both ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive) and ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pattern: {急|いそ}ぐ (hurry, be in a hurry—intransitive) / X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{急|いそ}ぐ (hurry X along—transitive, less common).

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing state. ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急いで：19486_isoide⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is in a hurry' or 'is rushing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急いで：19486_isoide⟧ (in a hurry—te-form used adverbially)
- {急|いそ}がなくて⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (don't need to hurry)
- ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急いで：19486_isoide⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is in a hurry)
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{急|いそ}ぐ (hurry the work along)

RELATED WORDS:
- {急|いそ}ぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧ (urgent business)
- お{急|いそ}ぎです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (Are you in a hurry? - polite)

CAUTION: {急|いそ}ぐ implies physical hurrying. For 'time is running out' or 'urgent,' use ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (na-adjective) instead.
